name: meta-ads-audit
description: Full Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad-account audit via the Meta Ads MCP or manual Ads Manager CSV exports, scored against a comprehensive 7-lever account-audit framework with a deterministic pre-scorer that machine-scores the mechanical checks. Emits a 3-format deliverable bundle from one findings payload — an Obsidian-ready markdown record, an interactive self-contained HTML report (the primary client-shareable deliverable), and a formula-driven xlsx backup — plus Concentration (HHI/Gini/Pareto-ABC) and Creative Signals (fatigue, reach saturation, effective frequency, ranking decomposition) analytics computed straight from the raw data files. Python stdlib only; openpyxl (>=3.1) needed only for the xlsx backup.

interface.shortDescription: Audit Meta Ads accounts with deterministic scoring.
interface.longDescription: Audit Meta Ads data from a connected account or CSV exports, machine-score mechanical checks, analyze concentration and creative signals, and produce synchronized Markdown, HTML, and XLSX reports.
defaultPrompt: Audit this Meta Ads account and rank the findings.
Analyze these Ads Manager exports for creative fatigue.
Build the Markdown, HTML, and XLSX audit bundle.
